scenes.heading: Negotiating your first brand sponsorship deal

sents.d: Negotiating your first brand sponsorship deal
Knowing your own numbers is the foundation of a fair negotiation.
Before negotiating any deal, knowing your own engagement rate, average views, and audience demographics (not just follower count) gives you the data to justify your asking price with any brand.

Brands often propose their first offer as a low anchor — countering with a specific number backed by your metrics, rather than an emotional response, tends to lead to a better final outcome than either immediately accepting or refusing to negotiate at all.
Clarifying exactly what's included in a deal — number of posts, platforms, usage rights, exclusivity period, whether the content must be evergreen — prevents scope confusion after the deal is agreed.

take: Negotiate with your real metrics and pin down the deliverables.
